source: A memory interface can sustain many transfers concurrently and therefore deliver enormous aggregate bandwidth while an individual dependent load still takes substantial time to complete. Those are different properties of the path.
zh: 内存接口可以同时支持许多传输，因此可以提供巨大的聚合带宽，而单个相关负载仍然需要大量时间才能完成。这些是路径的不同属性。
